CustomField.description: Unique Key for connecting Typeform responses to their related Case. Passed to Typeform from URL Parameter. URL Parameter created by survey embed in the email template sent by flow( Case_AccountSupport_SendSurveyResponseEmail). Used by Flow (SurveyResponse_CreateLookupRelationships) to create Lookup relationship to Case on creation. Hidden to all users expect Admins
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Hidden for all users except Admins. Used in automation to create lookup from Case to Feedback Survey Response.
CustomField.label: Case Id
